# IMPERIA COLD WAR — USA Gulf and northern Iraq programme integration.
# COLDWAR USA Gulf/northern Iraq. Generated by tools/iraq_1970/usa_module.py.
on_actions = {
    on_startup = { effect = { IRQ = { if = { limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes } COLDWAR_USA_gulf_irq_daily = yes } } } }
    # COLDWAR | hand patch 07.11.2026 (performance): runs only for the tag it is meant for (on_daily_TAG instead of a tag check in every country).
	on_daily_USA = { effect = {
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_campaign = yes tag = USA } COLDWAR_USA_gulf_usa_daily = yes }
	} }
	on_daily_IRQ = { effect = {
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_campaign = yes tag = IRQ } COLDWAR_USA_gulf_irq_daily = yes }
	} }
    on_capitulation = { effect = {
        if = { limit = { ROOT = { tag = IRQ COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes } }
            IRQ = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recent_defeat days = 180 value = 1 } }
        }
    } }
}
